verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents several natural-language paths. Its official MCP server lets users read workspace data, manage automations, sends and segments "all through natural language prompts." An in-product agent builds segments from plain-text descriptions, analyzes the workspace, runs scheduled tasks and takes requests in Slack. CLI skills and a Claude plugin let AI assistants drive the full workspace. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed; all evidence is vendor documentation plus a probe confirming the MCP docs page exists.
